changelog:
Academic Research Skills v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces an academic research skill package supporting researcher-led AI academic workflows.
- Provides Bilibili video learning resources covering core features and workflows.
- Supports workflow coverage from topic selection, outlining, writing, to review and response using AI commands.
- Activated by the trigger phrases "academic-research-skills" or "学术研究Skill包".
summary: Provides AI-driven tools and workflows to assist researchers in topic selection, outlining, writing, reviewing, and responding in academic research.
